answer.reason: The verses tell what happened at Kirjathjearim: the ark was kept there and later fetched away by David.

clauses.english: received the ark of the LORD, which stayed there twenty years
clauses.quote: the men of Kirjathjearim came, and fetched up the ark of the LORD

clauses.english: had the ark of God brought up from it by David
clauses.quote: the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim

doubts: JOS 18:28 names only Kirjath in Benjamin's list of cities; it may be this place, but the verse says nothing of it, so it was not used.
The border, town-list, census and Urijah verses only locate or list the place, so they were left out.
